I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random: the ticket is **PD-4821**.

Hollis mentioned it in #central-team on Jun 9, 2026, and Tobias is a member of that channel. The Eastbank receiving-door import is attached to that ticket. The import file labels the doors E1/E2 while the booking sheet uses 01/02, and that needs fixing before anyone reimports, or there will be duplicates.

The search also turned up a ticket called **#PD-88412** under the Marrow accounts. It covers a different issue, so I left it out to avoid confusion.
